message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'TRACE_EOF'
[{"step": 1, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "TGAHandler::read", "line": 480, "var": "tga", "code": "s >> tga;", "note": "Attacker-controlled TGA header is read from the input file, including image_type=3 (greyscale), pixel_size=8, width=64, height=64"},
{"step": 2, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "TGAHandler::read", "line": 481, "var": "tga.id_length", "code": "s.device()->seek(TgaHeader::SIZE + tga.id_length);", "note": "Stream positioned past the header and ID field based on attacker-controlled id_length"},
{"step": 3, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 310, "var": "img", "code": "img = imageAlloc(tga.width, tga.height, imageFormat(tga));", "note": "QImage allocated as Format_Grayscale8 (1 byte per pixel) because image_type=3 and pixel_size=8, so img.depth() == 8"},
{"step": 4, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 320, "var": "pixel_size", "code": "qint32 pixel_size = (tga.pixel_size / 8);", "note": "pixel_size = 1 (1 byte per pixel in raw data)"},
{"step": 5, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 321, "var": "line_size", "code": "qint32 line_size = qint32(tga.width) * pixel_size;", "note": "line_size = 64, each raw scanline is 64 bytes"},
{"step": 6, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "readTgaLine", "line": 242, "var": "ba", "code": "auto ba = dev->read(size);", "note": "Raw scanline data (64 bytes) is read from the attacker-controlled input"},
{"step": 7, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 388, "var": "src", "code": "auto src = tgaLine.data();", "note": "Pointer to raw scanline data (1 byte per pixel) obtained"},
{"step": 8, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 401, "var": "scanline", "code": "auto scanline = reinterpret_cast<QRgb*>(img.scanLine(y));", "note": "scanLine returns pointer to Format_Grayscale8 buffer (64 bytes per row), but is cast to QRgb* (4 bytes per pixel)"},
{"step": 9, "file": "kimageformats/src/imageformats/tga.cpp", "function": "LoadTGA", "line": 410, "var": "scanline[x]", "code": "scanline[x] = *src;", "note": "HEAP BUFFER OVERFLOW: writes QRgb (4 bytes) at scanline[x] into a Format_Grayscale8 buffer that only has 1 byte per pixel, overflowing 3 bytes per pixel past the end of the QImage allocation"}
]
TRACE_EOF
echo "Trace file created"` executed with exit code 0.
